153	  rather than guessing.

166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

181	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.

183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.

188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.

190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.

208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.

214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps

218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

120	        process: false,
121	        path: false,

7

12

15	```
16	
17	### 2. Installing the Markdown editor
18	Install the Markdown editor
19	
20	```bash
21	npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor
22	```
23	
24	### 3. Install peer dependencies
25	Ensure that you have the necessary dependencies listed in [peerDependencies](https://github.com/gravity-ui/markdown-editor/blob/main/package.json) and install it. Include the following packages:
26	- `@diplodoc/transform`
27	- `highlight.js`
28	- `katex`
29	- `lowlight`
30	- `markdown-it`
31	
32	### 4. Configuring the application
33	Add the `Editor.tsx`:
34	
35	```tsx
36	import React from 'react';
37	import {MarkdownEditorView, MarkupString, useMarkdownEditor} from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';
38	
39	export interface EditorProps {
40	  onSubmit: (value: MarkupString) => void;
41	}
42	
43	export const Editor: React.FC<EditorProps> = ({onSubmit}) => {
44	  const editor = useMarkdownEditor({
45	    md: {
46	      html: false,
47	    },
48	  });
49	
50	  React.useEffect(() => {
51	    function submitHandler() {
52	      // Serialize current content to markdown markup
53	      const value = editor.getValue();
54	      onSubmit(value);
55	    }
56	
57	    editor.on('submit', submitHandler);
58	    return () => {
59	      editor.off('submit', submitHandler);
60	    };
61	  }, [onSubmit]);
62	
63	  return <MarkdownEditorView stickyToolbar autofocus editor={editor} />;
64	};
65	```
66	
67	Update the `App.tsx` with `Editor` component:
68	
69	```tsx
70	import {ThemeProvider, Toaster, ToasterComponent, ToasterProvider} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
71	import {MarkupString} from '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor';
72	
73	import {Editor} from './Editor';
74	
75	const toaster = new Toaster();
76	
77	const App = () => {
78	  const handleSubmit = (value: MarkupString) => {
79	    console.log(value);
80	  };
81	
82	  return (
83	    <ThemeProvider theme="light">
84	      <ToasterProvider toaster={toaster}>
85	        <ToasterComponent />
86	        <Editor onSubmit={handleSubmit} />
87	      </ToasterProvider>
88	    </ThemeProvider>

96	To prevent errors related to missing polyfills for Node.js core modules in Webpack 5, such as:
97	
98	- `Can't resolve 'process'`

107	1. Install CRACO:

117	    configure: (webpackConfig) => {
118	      webpackConfig.resolve.fallback = {
119	        fs: false,
120	        process: false,
121	        path: false,

- `TextInput` с `label` — название;
- поле текста на `useMarkdownEditor` + `MarkdownEditorView`:

  - в **режиме разметки** (переключатель в тулбаре) включён split-view: слева сырой markdown, справа — живой предпросмотр;

**Прочее:** `configure({lang: 'ru'})` вызван для обоих пакетов (uikit и markdown-editor), интерфейс на русском; в `tsconfig.json` добавлен `esModuleInterop` — иначе `export =` у `@diplodoc/transform` не импортируется как default.
